messages:
jordan: Quick heads up — cutover window in ~30m. Both PRs below are blocking the release because we require 2x LGTM before cutoff. If we don't get two approvals we'll hold the change to the next window.
- PR 8134: runtime/kv-cache: prevent double-warm on fallback
- PR 8135: routing/smart-fallback: prioritize cheaper regional variant
Can reviewers please prioritize? I'm available for quick fixes.

sam: Reviewing 8134 now, running locally. Left one inline about the lock ordering, probably a 1-line fix.

alyssa: I have 8135. CI flaky on concurrency test, kicking a rerun now (ETA ~12m).

matt: I can give 8134 an approval once the lock nit is addressed. ping me when patched.

jordan: Noted. @matt thanks. @alyssa please post CI link when green so we can get second LGTM.

deploy-bot: CI update — PR 8134: tests passing; PR 8135: tests running (rerun queued).

sam: Pushed small fix for the lock ordering, CI triggered.

matt: LGTM on 8134 (codeowners ok). :+1:

alyssa: CI for 8135 is green after rerun. Fixed a timing assertion in the test.

emily: Giving 8135 LGTM — the change looks safe and tests are stable.

jordan: Awesome. That means both PRs have 2x LGTM now. Plan: I'll merge at T-10 unless someone flags a blocker. Merge order: 8134 then 8135. We'll watch the latency and error dashboards and roll back 8135 if errors > 2% in the 5min window.

jordan: Merge commands for reference:
```bash
# merge main PRs in order
hub merge 8134
hub merge 8135
# follow deploy steps in runbook: infra/runbooks/release-cutover.md
```

oncall-bot: Notifying eng-oncall about the cutover in 10m.

sam: No objections from my side. Good to merge when you are.

jordan: merging now.

deploy-bot: Merged PR 8134 (commit abc123). Deploy started: https://ci.redwood/runs/12345
deploy-bot: Merged PR 8135 (commit def456). Deploy started: https://ci.redwood/runs/12346

maria: Watching metrics — +1m: request p50 steady, error rate 0.3%. All good so far. :tada:

jordan: Thanks everyone — holding this thread open for 15m to confirm stability, then closing the window. If anything pops, @eng-oncall and I are on pager.
